Creates a new lead for the authenticated organization.

If no assignee is provided, the system automatically evaluates all
active Lead Assignment Rules and assigns the lead using the configured
assignment strategy.

- ROUND_ROBIN
- EQUAL_DISTRIBUTION

- Territory
- Product
- City
- State
- Budget Range

post.description:
Starts a background lead import for the authenticated organization.

Features:
- Multi-tenant validation
- CSV validation
- Duplicate detection (CSV + Database)
- Assignee validation
- 500-row transactional batches
- Activity logging
- Progress tracking
- Error CSV generation

The request returns immediately with an Import Job ID.

Use:
GET /api/leads/import/{jobId}

to monitor progress.

413.description: Uploaded file exceeds the maximum allowed size.

get.description:
Returns the current status and progress of a Lead CSV import job.

Possible status values:

- PENDING
- PROCESSING
- COMPLETED
- FAILED
- CANCELLED

The frontend can poll this endpoint while the
background import is running.

Downloads the validation error report generated for a Lead CSV import.

The error report contains every CSV row that failed validation
together with the corresponding reason.

Typical columns include:

- row
- reason
- name
- email
- phone
- company
- city
- source
- status
- assignedToId
- tags
- note

If the import completed without validation failures,
or no error report exists, this endpoint returns **404**.

400.description: Invalid organization or invalid job ID.

404.description: Error CSV or import job not found.

get.description:
Returns groups of duplicate leads within the authenticated user's organization.

Duplicate detection is performed using:

- Email
- Phone Number

For each duplicate group, the oldest lead is suggested as the primary lead.

Supports optional searching and limiting of duplicate groups.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search duplicate groups by lead name, email, phone, or company.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of duplicate groups to return.

403.description: User does not have permission to view duplicate leads.

post.description:
Merges a duplicate lead into a primary lead within the same organization.

The merge operation executes inside a single database transaction.

During the merge:

- Missing scalar fields are copied to the primary lead
- Lead Notes are transferred
- Lead Activities are transferred
- Organization Activities are transferred
- Lead Status History is transferred
- Lead Assignment History is transferred
- Tasks are transferred
- Meetings are transferred
- Emails are transferred
- Deals are transferred
- WhatsApp Conversations are transferred
- Lead Tags are merged without duplicates
- Merge audit activities are created
- The duplicate lead is permanently deleted

Both leads must belong to the authenticated user's organization.

400.description: Invalid request, validation failed, or both lead IDs are identical.

403.description: User does not have permission to merge leads.

404.description: Primary lead or duplicate lead not found.

get.description:
Performs a global search across multiple modules within the authenticated user's organization.

Supported entities:
- Leads (name, email, phone, company)
- Deals (name)
- Contacts (name, email, phone)
- Companies (name)
- Projects (name, description)
- Invoices (client name)
- Payments (Razorpay Order ID, Razorpay Payment ID)
- Meetings (title, location)
- Tasks (title, description)
- Documents (file name)
- Calls (notes, transcript)

Supports filtering by entity type and paginated results.

Every result contains:
- type (entity type)
- data (entity object)
